verdict.rationale: The card's official product page lists "AMD FSR™ 'Redstone'" as a feature, so AMD documents an FSR generation for this part. The pack contains nothing more: no description of what Redstone does (AI upscaling vs. frame generation) and no game-support list or count. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI upscaling and frame generation, evidence of broad game support, and independent or hands-on corroboration of FSR on this card.

support.subject: As a gamer, AI upscaling and frame generation are supported on this card — the DLSS or FSR generation is documented for this part, with broad game support
